notes: About pactum is laid out as in folia

entries.title: About pactum is laid out as in folia
entries.detail: Settings › About pactum starts with the icon. The build facts stand in two columns. The About tab counts the changes you have not read. The foot of Settings names the build.

entries.title: Get the Mac app is now in About
entries.detail: Settings › About pactum now holds the download of the Mac app. In a browser the Mac app part is gone, as it held nothing else. In the Mac app, that part keeps its hotkey, its icon and opening at login.

entries.title: Settings as in folia, by the same parts
entries.detail: Settings now use the same parts as folia and specula. The left side and the title look as they do there; the rest stays where it was.

entries.title: A hotkey, and Settings › Mac app
entries.detail: ⌃⌥⌘P shows or hides pactum from any app, and you can record other keys. Settings › Mac app also holds where the icon shows, opening at login, and the download.

entries.title: Account, Docs and What's New in Settings
entries.detail: Settings has an Account part: who uses this Mac, and what pactum holds. About has a Read group. Docs waits for a Field Manual.

entries.title: Settings, and pactum in English
entries.detail: The gear at the top right opens Settings. About pactum says which build this is and where your data lives. The whole app now speaks English.

entries.title: Starts without the Input folder too
entries.detail: When the Input folder is missing, pactum makes it and shows an empty page. Before, the server stopped.

entries.title: An icon of its own
entries.detail: The spider: five spokes, the KPI profile of a group, in the colours of the app family.

entries.title: pactum 1
entries.detail: The KPI comparison of the IT service groups, from the SLA workbook and the eTHIS exports.
